resources.string: Off: Min guest network is disabled by the kernel. On: the host proxy approves domains; proot limits connections to its loopback ports (best effort, subject to thread races). Network requests can fail when Android freezes the app.
Enforced by managed settings. Other allow lists and new approvals cannot widen it.
This domain will be accessed. Please confirm.
Commands still run as Min\'s Android identity. This applies to the Min engine; environment declarations in the terminal or external CLIs do not imply these limits.
